# ChartLegendPosition

`Flare.Components.ChartLegendPosition`

Where the legend sits relative to the plot in FlareChart.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Bottom` | `0` | Below the plot (the default). |
| `Top` | `1` | Above the plot. |
| `Left` | `2` | To the left of the plot. |
| `Right` | `3` | To the right of the plot. |
| `None` | `4` | No legend. |

## Used by components

- `FlareChart`
